mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the head and spine to the trunk was most worthwhile: seeing nerves and blood routes reach the same muscles tied separate systems together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the digestive tract into its named slot felt mostly like straightforward placement, with little to decide once the tract was built.

surprise.text: The diaphragm separating the chest from the abdomen while routes cross between them made their positions clearer.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary; the placements had named slots or visible connections. The final skin fitting was predictable and the only available combination.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter explored how the assembled systems interact; the final cutaway suggests more connections, though the repeated fitting became predictable.
